policy: No third-party repository was cloned, installed, copied, or executed. Choose at most three sources per creative task; check exact file, runtime, asset, model, and commercial terms before adopting.

sources.name: Blender Skills Pack
sources.focus: 3D modeling, materials, character/scene animation, optimization, and export workflows.
prerequisites: Blender MCP connected to a running Blender instance
sources.caveat: Desktop-oriented; not a Vercel or Android-phone renderer. Check licenses for any models and assets separately.

sources.name: Bang Motion
sources.focus: Original browser-based openers, promos, kinetic typography, product explainers, storyboards, and motion QA.
prerequisites: Optional Node, Puppeteer, and FFmpeg for capture/export
sources.caveat: Use as a workflow reference; source media, fonts, music, and logos need their own rights checks.

sources.name: Remotion Motion Graphics Skills
sources.focus: Kinetic text, cinematic camera movement, terminal demos, editorial highlights, render inspection, and video delivery.
prerequisites: Node/React and a local render environment
sources.caveat: MIT covers this skill repository, not every Remotion runtime/commercial-use term or third-party asset. Verify current terms before client work.

sources.name: Motion for React and JavaScript
sources.focus: Web UI transitions, layout animation, gestures, and micro-interactions.
prerequisites: Web project using React or JavaScript
sources.caveat: A development library, not a finished design or a hosted animation service.

sources.name: PixiJS
sources.focus: Interactive 2D scenes, illustration effects, particles, and performant canvas/WebGL experiences.
prerequisites: Browser/WebGL-capable device and a web build pipeline
sources.caveat: Use only when interaction or a 2D scene justifies the extra runtime; provide a low-motion fallback.

sources.name: SVG-edit
sources.focus: Browser-based vector illustration and SVG editing.
sources.caveat: SVG is editable source, not a guarantee that imported fonts or linked images are licensed.

sources.name: Penpot
sources.focus: Collaborative interface, brand-system, layout, and prototype design.
prerequisites: Penpot service/account or a separately operated self-hosted deployment
sources.caveat: No Penpot deployment or account was created; self-hosting needs separate infrastructure and security review.

sources.name: ComfyUI
sources.focus: Node-based local image-generation and media workflows with inspectable pipelines.
prerequisites: Usually a compatible GPU and separately acquired model files
sources.caveat: Model weights, datasets, custom nodes, and output rights have separate terms; never expose its local API publicly without authentication.

sources.name: Krita AI Diffusion
sources.focus: Krita-assisted image generation, inpainting, outpainting, and paint-over workflows.
prerequisites: Compatible local or authorized generation backend
sources.caveat: Not a phone/Vercel feature by itself; GPU/backend and model-license requirements are separate.

sources.name: Awesome Motion Design Agent Skills
sources.focus: Discovery index for motion libraries and agent skills, with license/prerequisite notes to verify at the source.
sources.caveat: A catalog is not an endorsement; each linked project's current license and safety must be checked separately.
